Name: Stardew Valley Defender
Author: Chaosstripe
Description:
Hey, you! Want to buy a weapon? Something new, unlike what you've used before? Tired of getting distracted in your mining by all those pesky enemies? Tired of dying to the hordes of bats, brutes, and serpents? Just want to really make sure you never pay a single cent to Harvey? If you said yes, then have I got a deal for you!

This mod uses Json Assets to add 13 new "weapons," which are naturally dispersed through the world of Stardew Valley. However, these aren't your normal weapons: These are shields. This means that they all boast a defense buff of scaling quality depending on the stage of the game it drops or is unlocked in. Of course defense is not the only trick in some of these shields, with others from super high knockback to super strong critical hits. However, they are shields, so base damage is at highest 20 points.

Due to the nature of this game, each shield is classified as either a Club, Sword, or Dagger, and has access to the special attack of that weapon type. Club types are slower but generally have the highest amounts of knockback, to slam foes out of your way. Sword types are more balanced and have access to the defensive special to punish attackers. Dagger types are faster, with less defense but more other abilities, like higher critical chances and damages. This does mean that this mod should be compatible with most weapon type specific mods, such as the combat trees of Walk Of Life.

Now get out there! Defend yourself, defend the Valley, and be prepared!
